title: The Informant
artist: 東都ナイト・アンサンブル
caption: Cool noir jazz instrumental with a twangy baritone electric guitar drenched in tremolo and spring reverb, walking upright bass, rim clicks and ride cymbal, a quiet Hammond organ pad, a muted trumpet answering the guitar. Shady, sly, a meeting in a back-alley bar. Warm vintage analog sound. No vocals.
